Row.Text: Hold Shift and click locked Technologies or Civics to queue several of them in order.
Once a day, at the main menu, asks alkeari.com for the newest version of Tech and Civic Queue and shows a short notice only when a newer one is out. Nothing else is sent.
Tech and Civic Queue {1_Latest} is out (you have {2_Current}). Update it on the Steam Workshop or Nexus Mods.
